findings.evidence: features/002-develop-skill/002-develop-skill-prd.md:AC-13 — 'Every per-task plan's first paragraph follows the format `"We're doing X because of PRD requirement Y. This aligns with Z."` where X paraphrases the task scope, Y is a literal `R{N}` from the feature's PRD, and Z paraphrases the requirement's `Serves goal:` field. Plans whose first paragraph doesn't match this format are a failed plan emission; Gate 4 must not be invoked until the format is satisfied.' AC-13 enforces a specific PRD-anchor format, but no R-level requirement in the Requirements section actually mandates this format. R10 mentions PRD anchor cross-checking ('Goal-Driven cross-checks the PRD anchor against the cited requirement ID') but doesn't define the anchor format itself. R16 covers orchestrator pattern compliance but doesn't touch plan formatting. The AC verifies a contract that no requirement establishes — orphan AC.
findings.claim: Coverage gap (orphan AC) — AC-13 verifies a PRD-anchor format that no R-level requirement explicitly mandates. Goal-Driven Execution principle: 'Every requirement is covered by at least one AC.' The inverse also holds: every AC must verify at least one stated requirement, otherwise the AC is testing a contract the PRD didn't make. AC-13's claim cites 'R10's PRD anchor cross-check' but R10 only requires that Goal-Driven Reviewer cross-checks the anchor at Gate 4 — R10 does NOT require any specific format for the plan's anchor. The anchor format is locked-in architecturally (`docs/PRD.md` § Phase 2 scope item 7: 'every plan starts with We're doing X because of PRD requirement Y') but the Phase-2 architectural rule has no R-level expression in this PRD body.
findings.proposed_change: Add a new requirement R17 that explicitly mandates the PRD-anchor format: 'R17. Per-task plan's PRD-anchor format. Every per-task plan's first paragraph follows the format `"We're doing X because of PRD requirement Y. This aligns with Z."` where X paraphrases the task scope, Y is a literal `R{N}` from the feature's PRD, and Z paraphrases the requirement's `Serves goal:` field. Trace: codebase context (pre-grilling) — Phase 2 § scope item 7 architectural rule. Serves goal: Outcome (PRD-anchored plan commentary).' Then update AC-13's `Verifies:` line to cite R17 specifically, not 'R10's PRD anchor cross-check'. This closes the orphan-AC gap and makes the architectural rule R-level enforceable.

findings.evidence: features/002-develop-skill/002-develop-skill-prd.md:Goal Outcome field + AC-1 through AC-14 — The goal's Outcome lists eight success surfaces: (a) plan with PRD anchor, (b) Gate 4 manifest, (c) code change set, (d) Gate 5 manifest, (e) Verifier confirmation, (f) PR with PRD anchor, (g) Linear status update, (h) `task-history.json` record extended with development-time fields. ACs 1-14 cover surfaces (a)-(g) but no AC verifies surface (h) — `task-history.json` extension with development-time fields. The interview's Round 6 covered Linear and Round 7 covered Verifier rejection; neither covered task-history.json extension explicitly, but the goal field names it as a success surface and `docs/PRD.md` Phase 3 scope item 1 establishes the schema fields (lane assigned, AI assistance level, time, what-worked, what-didn't, blast-radius outcome).
findings.claim: Goal-coverage gap — the Outcome field lists `task-history.json` record extension as a success surface, but no AC verifies that the skill writes the development-time fields on completion. A task-history.json entry that's missing these fields would still pass every other AC, leaving a goal-field unverified.
findings.proposed_change: Add an AC: 'AC-15. On task completion (Verifier passes OR option 4 accept-and-ship is chosen), the skill appends to (or updates) the matching `admin/task-history.json` entry with the development-time fields per Phase 3 scope item 1: `lane_assigned`, `ai_assistance_level`, `elapsed_minutes`, `what_worked`, `what_didnt_work`, `blast_radius_outcome`. The entry must trace to the task's pre-existing entry (created at task creation by `specflow:task` Phase D, if any) by id; if no prior entry exists, the skill creates one. Verifies: Goal Outcome surface (h).' Add a new requirement R18 if the Goal-coverage rule requires R-level expression as well; or treat AC-15 as a binding-the-skill-to-the-goal-field check that the architectural Phase 3 scope item already establishes (the goal field's mention is sufficient; R-level expression is optional).
